exit_checklist_item_done.value: status = 'pending' OR (done_by IS NOT NULL AND done_at IS NOT NULL)

exit_checklist_item_not_required.name: exit_checklist_item_not_required
exit_checklist_item_not_required.value: status <> 'not_required' OR (allow_not_required AND reason IS NOT NULL)

exit_checklist_item_evidence.name: exit_checklist_item_evidence
exit_checklist_item_evidence.value:
(evidence_type IS NULL) = (evidence_id IS NULL) AND (evidence_type IS NULL
        OR evidence_type IN ('statutory_notification', 'document', 'ledger_entry', 'note'))

exit_record_one_open.name: exit_record_one_open
exit_record_one_open.where: state NOT IN ('closed', 'cancelled') AND deleted_at IS NULL

exit_record_status_before.name: exit_record_status_before
exit_record_status_before.value: status_before IS NULL OR status_before IN ('active', 'on_leave', 'in_hospital')

exit_record_state.name: exit_record_state
exit_record_state.value:
state IN ('planned', 'left', 'recorded', 'awaiting_return', 'closed', 'cancelled') AND CASE WHEN kind = 'death'
        THEN state NOT IN ('planned', 'left') ELSE state <> 'recorded' END

exit_record_death.name: exit_record_death
exit_record_death.value:
CASE WHEN kind = 'death'
        THEN place_of_death IN ('care_home', 'hospital', 'elsewhere') AND left_at IS NOT NULL
        ELSE place_of_death IS NULL AND death_expected IS NULL END

exit_record_destination.name: exit_record_destination
exit_record_destination.value:
destination_type IS NULL OR destination_type IN ('own_home', 'family_home', 'care_home',
        'hospital', 'hospice', 'supported_living', 'other')

exit_record_left.name: exit_record_left
exit_record_left.value: state IN ('planned', 'cancelled') OR left_at IS NOT NULL

exit_record_cancelled.name: exit_record_cancelled
exit_record_cancelled.value: state <> 'cancelled' OR cancelled_reason IS NOT NULL

exit_record_closed.name: exit_record_closed
exit_record_closed.value: state <> 'closed' OR closed_at IS NOT NULL

hospital_transfer_one_open.name: hospital_transfer_one_open
hospital_transfer_one_open.where: returned_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

hospital_transfer_returned.name: hospital_transfer_returned
hospital_transfer_returned.value: returned_at IS NULL OR returned_at >= left_at

hospital_transfer_acknowledgement.name: hospital_transfer_acknowledgement
hospital_transfer_acknowledgement.value: (ack_by IS NULL) = (ack_at IS NULL) AND (ack_by IS NULL) = (ack_reason IS NULL)

key_issue_returned.name: key_issue_returned
key_issue_returned.value: returned_on IS NULL OR returned_on >= issued_on

key_issue_lost.name: key_issue_lost
key_issue_lost.value: reported_lost_on IS NULL OR reported_lost_on >= issued_on

key_issue_once.name: key_issue_once
key_issue_once.value: returned_on IS NULL OR reported_lost_on IS NULL

pre_admission_assessment_involvement.name: pre_admission_assessment_involvement
pre_admission_assessment_involvement.value: person_involved IS NOT FALSE OR involvement_reason IS NOT NULL

property_item_acknowledgement.name: property_item_acknowledgement
property_item_acknowledgement.value:
ack_signer IN ('person', 'representative', 'unable_to_sign') AND CASE WHEN ack_signer = 'unable_to_sign'
        THEN ack_unable_reason IS NOT NULL ELSE ack_name IS NOT NULL END

property_item_witness.name: property_item_witness
property_item_witness.value: witnessed_by IS NULL OR witnessed_by <> recorded_by

property_item_returned.name: property_item_returned
property_item_returned.value:
status <> 'returned' OR (returned_on IS NOT NULL AND return_recipient_name IS NOT NULL
        AND return_recipient_capacity IN ('person', 'representative', 'personal_representative', 'receiving_provider') AND returned_by IS NOT NULL
        AND return_signer IN ('person', 'representative', 'unable_to_sign'))

property_item_disposed.name: property_item_disposed
property_item_disposed.value:
status <> 'disposed' OR (disposed_on IS NOT NULL AND disposal_reason IS NOT NULL
        AND disposed_by IS NOT NULL AND disposal_witnessed_by IS NOT NULL
        AND disposal_witnessed_by <> disposed_by)

property_item_lost.name: property_item_lost
property_item_lost.value: status <> 'lost' OR (lost_on IS NOT NULL AND loss_incident_id IS NOT NULL)

review_record_family.name: review_record_family
review_record_family.value:
(kind = 'family_involvement') = (family_involvement_kind IS NOT NULL)
        AND (family_involvement_kind IS NULL OR family_involvement_kind IN ('attended_review', 'contributed', 'invited_declined', 'person_declines_involvement', 'no_family_or_representative'))

review_record_correction_reason.name: review_record_correction_reason
review_record_correction_reason.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL

sharing_decision_recipient.name: sharing_decision_recipient
sharing_decision_recipient.value:
CASE recipient_kind
        WHEN 'family' THEN recipient_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND recipient_tenant_user_id IS NULL
        WHEN 'professional' THEN recipient_tenant_user_id IS NOT NULL AND recipient_contact_id IS NULL
        WHEN 'link' THEN recipient_contact_id IS NULL AND recipient_tenant_user_id IS NULL
        ELSE false END

sharing_decision_consent_given_by.name: sharing_decision_consent_given_by
sharing_decision_consent_given_by.value: consent_given_by IS NULL OR consent_given_by IN ('person', 'authority_holder')

sharing_decision_authority_role.name: sharing_decision_authority_role
sharing_decision_authority_role.value: authority_role IS NULL OR authority_role IN ('lpa_health_welfare', 'lpa_property_finance', 'deputy_personal_welfare', 'deputy_property_affairs', 'appointee')

sharing_decision_withdrawn.name: sharing_decision_withdrawn
sharing_decision_withdrawn.value: withdrawn_at IS NULL OR withdrawn_reason IS NOT NULL

sharing_decision_suspended.name: sharing_decision_suspended
sharing_decision_suspended.value: suspended_at IS NULL OR suspended_reason IS NOT NULL

sharing_decision_order_sections.name: sharing_decision_order_sections
sharing_decision_order_sections.value:
(authority_order_sections IS NULL OR (cardinality(authority_order_sections) > 0
        AND authority_order_sections <@ ARRAY['about_me', 'daily_updates', 'photos', 'activities_and_visits', 'care_plan', 'health_summary', 'medicines', 'appointments', 'finance', 'benefits', 'documents']::text[]))
        AND (authority_role IS NULL
          OR authority_role NOT IN ('deputy_personal_welfare', 'deputy_property_affairs')
          OR authority_order_sections IS NOT NULL)

sharing_decision_suspension_open_key.name: sharing_decision_suspension_open_key
sharing_decision_suspension_open_key.where: lifted_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

sharing_decision_suspension_period.name: sharing_decision_suspension_period
sharing_decision_suspension_period.value: lifted_at IS NULL OR lifted_at > suspended_at

welcome_checklist_item_done.name: welcome_checklist_item_done
welcome_checklist_item_done.value: status = 'pending' OR (done_by IS NOT NULL AND done_at IS NOT NULL)

welcome_checklist_item_not_applicable.name: welcome_checklist_item_not_applicable
welcome_checklist_item_not_applicable.value: status <> 'not_applicable' OR (allow_not_applicable AND reason IS NOT NULL)

downtime_peep_location.name: downtime_peep_location
downtime_peep_location.default: 'the person''s PEEP in the fire file'

location_downtime_places.name: location_downtime_places
location_downtime_places.value:
char_length(btrim(downtime_mar_location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
        AND char_length(btrim(downtime_peep_location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
        AND (downtime_places_confirmed_at IS NULL) = (downtime_places_confirmed_by IS NULL)

notification_escalate_idx.name: notification_escalate_idx
notification_escalate_idx.where: acknowledged_at IS NULL AND escalate_at IS NOT NULL

tenant_staff_file_option.name: tenant_staff_file_option
tenant_staff_file_option.value: staff_file_option IS NULL OR staff_file_option IN ('staff_file.after_leaving', 'staff_file.to_75th_birthday')

tenant_ai_provider.name: tenant_ai_provider
tenant_ai_provider.value: ai_provider IS NULL OR ai_provider IN ('bedrock_london', 'bedrock_eu', 'anthropic', 'tenant_own')

evidence_pack_scope.name: evidence_pack_scope
evidence_pack_scope.value:
cardinality(location_ids) > 0 AND cardinality(person_ids) > 0
        AND array_position(location_ids, NULL) IS NULL AND array_position(person_ids, NULL) IS NULL

evidence_pack_recipient.name: evidence_pack_recipient
evidence_pack_recipient.value:
btrim(recipient_name) <> '' AND btrim(recipient_organisation) <> ''
        AND recipient_email = lower(btrim(recipient_email))
        AND recipient_email ~ '^[!-~]+@[!-~]+\.[!-~]+$'

evidence_pack_released.name: evidence_pack_released
evidence_pack_released.value: (state IN ('released', 'revoked')) = (released_by IS NOT NULL AND released_at IS NOT NULL)

evidence_pack_revoked.name: evidence_pack_revoked
evidence_pack_revoked.value:
(state = 'revoked') = (revoked_by IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL
        AND revocation_reason IS NOT NULL AND btrim(revocation_reason) <> '')

evidence_pack_discarded.name: evidence_pack_discarded
evidence_pack_discarded.value:
(state = 'discarded') = (discarded_by IS NOT NULL AND discarded_at IS NOT NULL
        AND discard_reason IS NOT NULL AND btrim(discard_reason) <> '')

evidence_pack_bundle_deleted.name: evidence_pack_bundle_deleted
evidence_pack_bundle_deleted.value:
(deleted_at IS NULL) = (content IS NOT NULL)
        AND (deleted_at IS NULL) = (deletion_reason IS NULL)
        AND (deletion_reason IS NULL
          OR deletion_reason IN ('link_ended', 'pack_revoked', 'pack_discarded'))
        AND (content IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(content) = 'object')

evidence_pack_item_exclusion.name: evidence_pack_item_exclusion
evidence_pack_item_exclusion.value:
exclusion_reason IS NULL OR (exclusion_reason IN ('restricted_record', 'outside_date_range', 'location_not_requested', 'not_tagged', 'statement_not_requested', 'person_not_in_scope')
        AND fields = '[]'::jsonb AND supersedes_id IS NULL)

evidence_pack_link_revoked.name: evidence_pack_link_revoked
evidence_pack_link_revoked.value:
(revoked_at IS NULL) = (revocation_reason IS NULL)
        AND (revocation_reason IS NULL
          OR revocation_reason IN ('pack_revoked', 'reissued'))

evidence_pack_link_code_valid.name: evidence_pack_link_code_valid
evidence_pack_link_code_valid.value: valid_until > issued_at AND valid_until <= issued_at + interval '10 minutes'

evidence_pack_link_code_used.name: evidence_pack_link_code_used
evidence_pack_link_code_used.value: used_at IS NULL OR used_at >= issued_at

statement_of_purpose_version_approved.name: statement_of_purpose_version_approved
statement_of_purpose_version_approved.value: (state IN ('approved', 'superseded')) = (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)

statement_of_purpose_version_notificatio.name: statement_of_purpose_version_notification_due
statement_of_purpose_version_notificatio.value: (kind = 'revision' AND approved_at IS NOT NULL) = (notification_due_at IS NOT NULL)

statement_of_purpose_version_notified.name: statement_of_purpose_version_notified
statement_of_purpose_version_notified.value:
(notified_at IS NULL) = (notified_by IS NULL)
        AND (notified_at IS NULL) = (notification_evidence IS NULL)
        AND (notification_evidence IS NULL OR btrim(notification_evidence) <> '')
        AND (notified_at IS NULL OR (kind = 'revision' AND notified_at >= approved_at))

legal_hold_target.name: legal_hold_target
legal_hold_target.value: "legal_hold"."person_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("legal_hold"."subject_type" IS NOT NULL AND "legal_hold"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL)

rota_publication_counts.name: rota_publication_counts
rota_publication_counts.value: shift_count >= 0 AND open_shift_count >= 0 AND override_count >= 0 AND working_time_breaches >= 0 AND working_time_conditionals >= 0 AND (notice_minutes IS NULL OR notice_minutes >= 0)

shift_times.name: shift_times
shift_times.value: ends_at > starts_at AND ends_at - starts_at <= interval '25 hours' AND break_minutes >= 0

shift_cancelled.name: shift_cancelled
shift_cancelled.value: (deleted_at IS NULL) = (cancel_reason IS NULL) AND (cancel_reason IS NULL OR btrim(cancel_reason) <> '')

shift_assignment_removed.name: shift_assignment_removed
shift_assignment_removed.value: (deleted_at IS NULL) = (remove_reason IS NULL) AND (remove_reason IS NULL OR btrim(remove_reason) <> '')

shift_template_minutes.name: shift_template_minutes
shift_template_minutes.value: start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND end_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND break_minutes >= 0

candour_record_threshold.name: candour_record_threshold
candour_record_threshold.value:
(threshold_notifiable IS NULL) = (threshold_decided_at IS NULL)
        AND (threshold_notifiable IS NULL OR threshold_decided_by IS NOT NULL)

incident_severity.name: incident_severity
incident_severity.value: severity IS NULL OR severity IN ('negligible', 'minor', 'moderate', 'major', 'catastrophic')

incident_harm_grade.name: incident_harm_grade
incident_harm_grade.value: harm_grade IS NULL OR harm_grade IN ('none', 'low', 'moderate', 'severe', 'fatal')

incident_closed.name: incident_closed
incident_closed.value: (status = 'closed') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_by IS NOT NULL AND closed_reason IS NOT NULL)

incident_closed_by_other.name: incident_closed_by_other
incident_closed_by_other.value: closed_by IS NULL OR closed_by <> raised_by

incident_found_at.name: incident_found_at
incident_found_at.value: found_at IS NULL OR found_at >= occurred_at

incident_person_one_person.name: incident_person_one_person
incident_person_one_person.where: person_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

incident_person_one_user.name: incident_person_one_user
incident_person_one_user.where: tenant_user_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

incident_person_kind.name: incident_person_kind
incident_person_kind.value:
kind IN ('service_user', 'worker', 'other_not_at_work')
        AND (kind = 'service_user') = (person_id IS NOT NULL)
        AND (kind <> 'worker' OR tenant_user_id IS NOT NULL OR other_name IS NOT NULL)
        AND (kind <> 'other_not_at_work' OR other_name IS NOT NULL)
        AND (kind = 'worker' OR tenant_user_id IS NULL)

investigation_method.name: investigation_method
investigation_method.value:
method IS NULL OR method IN ('root_cause_analysis', 'five_whys', 'fishbone',
        'after_action_review', 'swarm_huddle', 'other')

investigation_completed.name: investigation_completed
investigation_completed.value:
(status = 'completed') = (completed_at IS NOT NULL)
        AND (status = 'open' OR (findings IS NOT NULL AND lessons IS NOT NULL))

statutory_notification_not_required.name: statutory_notification_not_required
statutory_notification_not_required.value: status <> 'not_required' OR not_required_reason IS NOT NULL

statutory_notification_submitted.name: statutory_notification_submitted
statutory_notification_submitted.value:
status <> 'submitted' OR (submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_by IS NOT NULL
        AND (external_reference IS NOT NULL OR evidence_document_id IS NOT NULL))

statutory_notification_dols.name: statutory_notification_dols
statutory_notification_dols.value:
(kind = 'cqc_reg18_dols_outcome') = (dols_authorisation_id IS NOT NULL)
        AND (dols_authorisation_id IS NULL OR person_id IS NOT NULL)

sub_processor_response_kind.name: sub_processor_response_kind
sub_processor_response_kind.value:
CASE kind
        WHEN 'acknowledged' THEN grounds IS NULL AND resolution IS NULL AND responded_by IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'objected' THEN notice_id IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim(grounds)) BETWEEN 20 AND 4000
          AND resolution IS NULL AND responded_by IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'objection_resolved' THEN notice_id IS NOT NULL AND grounds IS NULL
          AND resolution IN ('objection_withdrawn', 'not_used_for_tenant', 'services_ended')
        ELSE false END

device_binding_revocation.name: device_binding_revocation
device_binding_revocation.value: (revoked_at IS NULL AND revoked_by IS NULL AND revocation_reason IS NULL) OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_by IS NOT NULL AND revocation_reason IN ('lost_or_stolen', 'staff_left', 'access_withdrawn', 'replaced', 'other'))

device_discard_record_count.name: device_discard_record_count
device_discard_record_count.value: entry_count IS NULL OR entry_count BETWEEN 0 AND 100000

discard_reason_label.name: discard_reason_label
discard_reason_label.value: char_length(btrim(label)) BETWEEN 3 AND 120 AND (label_cy IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(label_cy)) BETWEEN 3 AND 120)

refused_entry_status.name: refused_entry_status
refused_entry_status.value: http_status IS NULL OR http_status BETWEEN 100 AND 599

clock_event_nfc.name: clock_event_nfc
clock_event_nfc.value: (evidence = 'nfc') = (nfc_tag_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (nfc_tag_ref IS NULL OR nfc_tag_ref ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')

timesheet_entry_clock_in_key.name: timesheet_entry_clock_in_key
timesheet_entry_clock_in_key.where: clock_in_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_id IS NULL

timesheet_entry_one_correction_key.name: timesheet_entry_one_correction_key
timesheet_entry_one_correction_key.where: supersedes_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

timesheet_entry_clock_out_key.name: timesheet_entry_clock_out_key
timesheet_entry_clock_out_key.where: clock_out_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_id IS NULL

timesheet_entry_travel.name: timesheet_entry_travel
timesheet_entry_travel.value: (kind = 'travel') = (travel IS NOT NULL) AND (travel IS NULL OR travel IN ('between_assignments', 'home_to_first_assignment', 'last_assignment_to_home', 'commute_to_fixed_workplace'))

timesheet_entry_mileage.name: timesheet_entry_mileage
timesheet_entry_mileage.value: mileage_tenths IS NULL OR (kind = 'travel' AND mileage_tenths BETWEEN 0 AND 100000)

timesheet_entry_times.name: timesheet_entry_times
timesheet_entry_times.value: ended_at > started_at AND ended_at - started_at <= interval '25 hours'

timesheet_entry_approved.name: timesheet_entry_approved
timesheet_entry_approved.value: (status = 'approved') = (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> worker_id)

timesheet_entry_correction.name: timesheet_entry_correction
timesheet_entry_correction.value: (supersedes_id IS NULL) = (correction_reason IS NULL) AND (correction_reason IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(correction_reason)) BETWEEN 3 AND 500)

working_time_opt_out_ends.name: working_time_opt_out_ends
working_time_opt_out_ends.value: ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= signed_on

working_time_opt_out_notice.name: working_time_opt_out_notice
working_time_opt_out_notice.value: (notice_amount IS NULL) = (notice_unit IS NULL) AND (notice_unit IS NULL OR (notice_unit IN ('days', 'months') AND notice_amount BETWEEN 0 AND 365))

working_time_opt_out_notice_given.name: working_time_opt_out_notice_given
working_time_opt_out_notice_given.value: notice_given_on IS NULL OR notice_given_on >= signed_on

task_sync_open_source_key.name: task_sync_open_source_key
task_sync_open_source_key.where: status IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('sync.device_hold', 'sync.entry_reported_deleted', 'sync.entry_deleted_after_upload', 'care.refused_entry_review')

task_cancel_code.name: task_cancel_code
task_cancel_code.value: cancel_code IS NULL OR (status = 'cancelled' AND cancel_code IN ('paused_while_away', 'ended_at_exit', 'exit_recorded_in_error', 'planned_exit_cancelled', 'missed_before_return_recorded'))

task_restore_code.name: task_restore_code
task_restore_code.value: restore_code IS NULL OR restore_code IN ('caught_up', 'answered_while_stopped')

task_series_care_plan_action_key.name: task_series_care_plan_action_key
task_series_care_plan_action_key.where: source_type = 'care_plan_action' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (active OR inactive_code IS NOT NULL)

task_series_inactive_code.name: task_series_inactive_code
task_series_inactive_code.value: inactive_code IS NULL OR (NOT active AND inactive_code IN ('paused_while_away', 'ended_at_exit', 'exit_recorded_in_error', 'planned_exit_cancelled', 'missed_before_return_recorded'))

compliance_item_risk_assessment.name: compliance_item_risk_assessment
compliance_item_risk_assessment.value:
(risk_assessment_signed_on IS NULL) = (risk_assessment_signed_by IS NULL)
        AND (risk_assessment_signed_on IS NULL OR kind = 'dbs_certificate')

revalidation_evidence_counts.name: revalidation_evidence_counts
revalidation_evidence_counts.value:
practice_hours BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND cpd_hours BETWEEN 0 AND 1000
        AND participatory_cpd_hours BETWEEN 0 AND cpd_hours
        AND feedback_pieces BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND reflective_accounts BETWEEN 0 AND 100

staff_profile_registration_body.name: staff_profile_registration_body
staff_profile_registration_body.value: registration_body IS NULL OR registration_body IN ('nmc', 'hcpc', 'swe', 'gmc')

staff_profile_left_after_start.name: staff_profile_left_after_start
staff_profile_left_after_start.value: left_on IS NULL OR starts_on IS NULL OR left_on >= starts_on

training_record_tier.name: training_record_tier
training_record_tier.value: (tier IS NULL) = (topic <> 'oliver_mcgowan') AND (tier IS NULL OR tier IN (1, 2))

training_record_expiry.name: training_record_expiry
training_record_expiry.value: expires_on IS NULL OR expires_on >= completed_on

training_record_provider.name: training_record_provider
training_record_provider.value: provider IS NULL OR length(btrim(provider)) BETWEEN 2 AND 160

training_requirement_refresh.name: training_requirement_refresh
training_requirement_refresh.value: refresh_years IS NULL OR refresh_years BETWEEN 1 AND 10

training_requirement_tier.name: training_requirement_tier
training_requirement_tier.value: (tier IS NULL) = (topic <> 'oliver_mcgowan') AND (tier IS NULL OR tier IN (1, 2))
